quotations.old_english: Ðonne sceal gehwá him æteówian hwæt he mid ðam punde geteolod hæfþ
quotations.english: then shall every one show to him what he has gained with the pound

source_text: ge-teolod; part. Gained; lucr&i-short;factus :-- Ðonne sceal gehwá him æteówian hwæt he mid ðam punde geteolod hæfþ then shall every one show to him what he has gained with the pound, Homl. Th. ii. 558, 10. v. ge-tilian.
